text:
This tremendous love raised high

is leaving me almost without entrails,

-O wasteland of expanded ardors!-

where I hear my voices as though strange.


Make my blood serene in the intimate

cabins of your being and your care,

and keep me in the enamored air

with which at times you deceive my pain.


If my flame hurts you, O clear fountain,

I will erase the moist cloudbanks

that your eyelids warmly kindle.


I will return their landscapes to your skies,

nailing deep into your eyes

the gentle orchards of my savage ardor.

translation.title: It Is Leaving Me Almost Without Entrails...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the poem's paradoxes: raised love, clear fountain, gentle orchards, savage ardor.
